name: Icon Swap
summary: Copy → Copied: the glyph swaps to a checkmark (SF Symbols Replace on iOS 17+, spring cross-fade on 16), .success haptic lands as the checkmark appears, then it swaps back on its own, silently.

accessibility.reduceMotion: no scale, no Replace effect; 0.15 s cross-fade; same .success haptic, at +0.10 s
accessibility.voiceOver: label names the action ("Copy") and never changes; value is "Copied" while swapped, spoken on the activated element; both strings injectable

sources: Apple, Human Interface Guidelines: SF Symbols, Animations (Replace, Magic Replace)
Vercel, Geist design system: copy button

states.motion: `from` glyph at rest in a fixed size × size box
iOS 17+: contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace.downUp)) under spring 0.3/0.8; iOS 16: same spring cross-fade, incoming 0.6→1, outgoing 1→0.6
states.haptic: .success at +100 ms, as the `to` glyph appears; dropped if reverted first

states.motion: same transition back to `from`, after revertAfter (1.5 s; 0 = never) or at once when trigger goes false
states.haptic: none: a timer or the caller did it, not a tap
